functions.name: CMapCompileModifierCS2BombDamage::Run
functions.note: bombsites, build, distances, then the .vdata (cs2_baked_bomb_damage_data, /baked_bomb_damage.vdata) saved as a child; grid 10, 32

functions.name: CCS2BombDamageBaker::SampleNavAreas
functions.note: per area, per fan triangle (v0, v[n-1], v[n-2]) down: cells of the area bounds snapped through fmod, y x z from the top, box half 10 against the triangle (1803f2400); bounds of every hit

functions.name: CCS2BombDamageBaker::BuildGrid
functions.note: top seed cells lifted 30 into the node table (+0x11 written out), site membership by the trigger overlapping the cell box (vtable +0xd0); rounds of zero-length box casts (vphysics2 +0x558) growing 5 diagonal-down steps within the bounds +-30, at most 64

functions.name: CCS2BombDamageBaker::PopulateNodeDistancesFromBombsite
functions.note: frontier from the distance-0 nodes, every node into the site table, 26-neighbour jobs then applied in order; frontier tables swapped and emptied in place

functions.name: CCS2BombDamageBaker::PopulateNodeDistancesFromBombsite::lambda_1
functions.note: one neighbour: parent shortcut to the grandparent when the line is clear, cost from the path, next frontier when not blocked

functions.name: CCS2BombDamageBaker::LineBlocked
functions.note: a ray each way (vphysics2 +0x4f8); FLT_MAX ends blocked, equal ends clear

functions.name: CCS2BombDamageBaker::BuildPath
functions.note: parents back to distance 0 or a self parent, the candidate standing in for its node; null on a cycle

functions.name: CCS2BombDamageBaker::PathLength
functions.note: segment lengths (z^2 + y^2 + x^2) summed four at a time

functions.name: CCS2BombDamageBaker::PathTurns
functions.note: acosf of each corner in degrees (57.29577637), none under 0.01 per axis

functions.name: CCS2BombDamageBaker::GatherRuntimeData
functions.note: written-out nodes in slot order: distance clamped to 16 bits, yaw and pitch bytes, leaning to the site within 1600

functions.name: CCS2BombDamageBaker::WriteVdata
functions.note: positions (int16 x, y, z - 30) and damage_values blobs

functions.name: BoxTriangleOverlap
functions.note: Akenine-Moller SAT: triangle bounds, unit edges against the axes, unit normal; tolerance added to the reach

functions.name: VectorNormalizeWide
functions.note: double precision: (y^2 + x^2) + z^2, components times 1 / length

functions.name: BombNodeTable::Insert
functions.note: CUtlHashtable, key hash MurmurHash2 mix of the float bits, seed 0xea711bd8

functions.name: BombNodeTable::Rehash
functions.note: next power of two of max(n, 32), re-placed from the last slot

functions.name: BombNodeTable::Bump
functions.note: the run's entry to the first free slot past the run, FLAG_LAST moves
